To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the specific contact layer between gold bumps and Al pads with a Ti/W barrier layer has been measured to be about 1.25 mu Omega mu m2 at room temperature and increases visibly after annealing above 350 degrees C, and the activation energy of this process is about 1 eV, which means that this process is diffusion controlled.
the specific contact layer resistance of Au bump-TiAl pad structure is about 1 mu Omega mu m2, which is higher than that of an Au bump-Al pad structure.
the TiW layer can be used as a diffusion barrier to prevent intermetallic formation between gold and aluminium.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the electrical properties of the contact layer of the Au bump-Ti-W-Al pad structure.
the effect of heat treatment on the specific contact layer resistance between gold and aluminium.
the effect of annealing temperature on the specific contact layer resistance for the structure of an Au bump-Tiw-Al pad.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the barrier function of the barrier layer is maintained after the heat treatment.
the TiW layer is an effective barrier to the diffusion of the metallic elements in the Au bump-Al pad system, and the barrier layer is stable up to 400 degrees C.
the TiW layer is effective in reducing the contact resistivity of the Au-Al system.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the specific contact resistivity between gold and aluminium with a TiW layer is much smaller and more stable than that between gold and aluminium without a TiW layer, which is very important for the fabrication of flip-chip packages.
the specific contact layer is a function of the diffusion coefficient and the diffusion length.
the TiW layer acts as a barrier for the formation of interfacial intermetallic compounds between Au and Al, but the barrier function of TiW decreases with an increase in temperature.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the specific contact layer resistance of Au bump-TiAl pad structure is lower and less sensitive to heat treatment than that for the structure without the TiW barrier layer, and that the specific contact resistivity of Au bump-Til pad structures is lower than that for Au bump-Ti pad structures.
the TiW layer does not prevent the formation of Au3Al and AuAl2 compounds but does reduce the formation rate of the compounds.
it is possible to use a TiW barrier to improve the reliability and stability of Au bump-Ti/Al pad structures.
